model.name: RbTraceTree.renderCurrentSprintEagerLazy
model.description: Render the trace tree: (1) CurrentSprint node top; (2) eager-lazy Sprints collection — sprint NODES eager, each sprint's TASKS resolved LAZILY on expand via the SHARED lazy-resolve loader (R26.1 pluggable IOR loader / R26.4 resolveChildrenLazily) — the SAME primitive federation uses for @host children, NOT a 2nd tree-specific loader. Structure-eager/payload-lazy, correct-by-construction single loader.
